sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head pale yellowish brown to blackish brown, slightly paler posteriorly, labrum yellowish brown, antennae, pronotum and legs yellowish white, mandibles blackish brown; body length (including mandibles, excluding antennae) 4.50—4.60 mm. Head slightly rectangular, about 1.5 times as long as wide, the lateral and posterior margins weakly convex; frons inclined forward from the anterior fifth; antenna 13-segmented, segment 2 nearly twice segment 3, segment 4 1.5 times as long as segment 3; labrum tongue-shaped; mandibles extremely slender, the inner margin with fine but distinct serrations, the apex pointed and weakly incurved, with a distinct tooth slightly below the middle of the inner margin of each mandible, the mandibles about two-thirds as long as the head; postmentum club-shaped, slightly more than twice as long as its maximum width. Alate not described. Compared with M. minutus, whose mandibles are more than half the head length: head larger (length 1.17—1.18 mm, width 0.81—0.83 mm), head-mandible length index 0.64.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellowish brown to blackish brown, slightly paler posteriorly; labrum yellowish brown; antennae, pronotum and legs yellowish white; mandibles blackish brown. Head very sparsely hairy, the pronotum more densely hairy, the abdomen with still more hairs. Body length (including mandibles, excluding antennae) 4.50—4.60 mm. Head slightly rectangular, the lateral and posterior margins weakly convex, about 1.5 times as long as wide, the anterolateral corners not projecting, the posterolateral corners broadly rounded; Y-shaped suture indistinct; frons inclined forward from the anterior fifth. Antenna 13-segmented, segment 2 nearly twice segment 3, segment 4 1.5 times as long as segment 3, segment 3 the shortest and narrowest, the segments lengthening from segment 5 on up to the penultimate, the last segment elongate-oval. Postclypeus strongly sclerotized, distinctly wider than long, the anterior margin with several erect hairs; anteclypeus white, band-like, more than twice as wide as long, hairless. Labrum tongue-shaped, slightly wider than long, the lateral margins weakly convex and weakly narrowed forward, the apex rounded, with 2 erect hairs below the apical margin. Mandibles extremely slender, the inner margin with fine but distinct serrations, the apex pointed and weakly incurved, with a distinct tooth slightly below the middle of the inner margin of each mandible, the mandibles about two-thirds as long as the head. Postmentum club-shaped, slightly more than twice as long as its maximum width, the waist width only slightly more than half the maximum width and situated at the anterior third, the anterior margin nearly straight, the posterior margin weakly concave. Pronotum distinctly saddle-shaped, the anterior lobe distinctly raised with a broadly rounded apical margin and no median notch, about 1.5 times as long as wide and distinctly narrower than the head width; posterior margin nearly straight; margins with several erect hairs and microsetae. Legs slender and long, hairy, tibial spur formula 3:2:2. Abdomen elongate, hairy. Measurements (holotype and range of 2 individuals, mm): head length (to mandible base) 1.18 (1.17—1.18); head width 0.83 (0.81—0.83); head height 0.62 (0.60—0.62); head index (width/length) 0.70 (0.69—0.70); labrum length 0.20 (0.18—0.20), width 0.24; left mandible length 0.75 (0.75—0.76); head-mandible length index 0.63 (0.63—0.65); postmentum median length 0.70; maximum postmentum width 0.34 (0.33—0.34); postmentum waist width 0.21 (0.20—0.21); pronotum length 0.30 (0.29—0.30), width 0.54; pronotum/head width index 0.65 (0.65—0.67); pronotum length/width index 0.55 (0.54—0.55); antenna 13-segmented.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head, labrum, antennae and pronotum yellowish brown; abdomen yellowish white. Head moderately hairy, the pronotum sparsely hairy, the abdomen moderately hairy. Body length (excluding antennae) 3.40—4.10 mm. Head nearly square, the lateral margins slightly expanding anteriorly, the posterior margin rounded; fontanelle indistinct; eyes and ocelli absent. Antenna 13-segmented, segment 3 the shortest and nearly half as long as segment 2 or segment 4, the segments enlarging from segment 5 on, the last segment oval and the longest. Postclypeus rather strongly sclerotized and rather raised, with a distinct median longitudinal line, sparsely hairy; anteclypeus narrow, band-like, white, projecting forward in the middle of its distal part, hairless. Labrum distinctly wider than long, the lateral margins convex, the anterior margin nearly straight, with several hairs at the apex and on its body. Left mandible with 1 apical and 2 marginal teeth at the apex, the apical tooth finger-like, the first marginal tooth blunt and close to the apical tooth, the second marginal tooth small and blunt and far below the first marginal tooth, the inner margin between them shallowly concave; the right mandible likewise with 1 apical and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth finger-like and slightly pointed, the first marginal tooth nearly triangular and slightly smaller than the apical tooth, the second marginal tooth smaller, blunt, adjacent to the first marginal tooth and with a long posterior margin; molar plate large, with oblique fine ridges. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, much wider than long, the anterior lobe rounded without a median notch, the posterior margin convex without a median depression. Legs hairy, tibial spur formula 3:2:2. Abdomen elongate, hairy. Measurements (5 individuals, mm): head length (to mandible base) 0.69—0.75; head width 0.76—0.80; head height 0.38—0.42; labrum length 0.26—0.28, width 0.34—0.35; pronotum length 0.14—0.17, width 0.38—0.42.

note: Adapted from species No. 24, "Microcerotermes insularis sp. nov.", in Maiti & Chakraborty (1994) "Termite fauna (Isoptera) of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Indian Ocean" (Records of the Zoological Survey of India, Occasional Paper No. 167), original in English; the alate is recorded in the original as "Unknown", and only the soldier and the worker are described. The item-by-item comparisons with M. minutus, M. minor, M. heimi, M. tenuignathus and M. biswanathae, the type specimens and type locality (Bakultala, Middle Andaman), the distribution and the illustrations in the original have not been entered; the figure of 0.14—0.17 mm for the worker pronotum length is transcribed from the original table as given.
